title: Tool Chooser Fidelity Scanner & Argument Fuzzing Pipeline
creator: Aisha Mann
description: Build an automated evaluation harness that scans model/config changes and measures tool-selection accuracy and argument validation robustness. The harness will (1) synthesize and run a diverse suite of prompts against candidate models + routing configs, (2) measure precision/recall of selected tool endpoints and argument schema conformance, and (3) produce pass/fail signals integrated into CI and canary rollouts. This ticket covers pipeline implementation, baseline datasets, metric definitions, CI gating, and monitoring hooks for rolling regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Baseline dataset of 4,500 instrumented prompts covering: disambiguation, tool-ambiguity, multi-tool intent, and adversarial arg cases exists in s3://redwood-evals/toolchooser/v1
Tool-selection evaluator computes precision@1, precision@3, and calibration gap and stores results as time-series to metrics-store (prometheus + long-term archive)
Argument validation evaluator computes schema F1, missing-arg rate, and coerced-type rate and annotates failing examples for manual review
CI integration: any PR that changes model or routing config triggers the harness; threshold breaches set PR to Blocked and post a failure comment with summary and top 10 failing prompts
Canary gating: canary rollout requires no regression >2% absolute drop in tool-selection precision@1 and argument F1 below 0.90 over baseline
Runbook and dashboard tiles in Console with token-level cost for eval runs and top failing prompt clusters
test_plan: Add new pipeline job in evals-cluster: toolchooser-scan-v2 (k8s cron or CI runner)
Map each candidate model config (model, quantization, routing policy) to a test matrix and run per-row evals with 3 random seeds for non-determinism
Collect outputs: selected_tool_id, tool_confidence, args_json, model_logits where available
Run selection-scoring: compare selected_tool_id to ground-truth label, compute precision@1/3 and confusion matrix
Run arg-validation: validate args_json against tool schemas, compute per-field precision/recall/F1 and delta vs baseline
Aggregate and push metrics to prometheus and write per-run artifacts to s3 for inspection
Fail PR if any threshold in acceptance_criteria is violated and annotate GitHub PR with artifact links
monitoring_plan: Create a Console dashboard tile: ToolChooser > Precision@1 (24h/7d) with sparklines and runbook link
Alert when a rolling 3-day drop in precision@1 exceeds 1.5% absolute or argument-F1 drops below 0.9
Postgres table of failing examples for triage with clustering labels and assigned owner
Daily regression report email to ML infra and Product with top 20 failures and suggested mitigations
Link to automatic rollback trigger in Dedicated deployments when canary meets regression criteria
implementation_notes: We will reuse parts of the existing eval harness but replace the tool-matching logic with a fuzzy-matcher that tolerates aliasing and versioned tool IDs
Argument fuzzing component will generate edge-case inputs (missing keys, wrong types, long strings, encoded payloads) and combine with intent paraphrases
Costs estimate: ~1200 eval-hours per model-config combination; will run on spot pool with budget cap and sampling schedule to limit spend
Privacy: test data should not include customer PII; use redwood-synth dataset and sanitized production anecdotes only with approvals
Expect incremental rollout: start with 10% sample of prompts in CI, expand to full suite for nightly runs
risks_and_mitigation: False positives due to label ambiguity — mitigation: add human-in-the-loop triage for top-k failures and iterative label improvements
High compute cost for exhaustive matrix — mitigation: adaptive sampling and early stopping when metrics converge
Schema drift for tools — mitigation: nightly schema sync job and schema-compatibility test in CI
Blocking CI on noisy signals — mitigation: use soft warnings for first two weeks then flip to hard gating after stability window
